decisions.reason: Confirming the authoritative final file does not change the existing constraint excluding the unintended newline marker from the book title.
The final-file confirmation does not alter the approved passages, editorial goal, or duplicate-full-stop constraint owned by this Requirement.
The source confirms a final manuscript file and does not resolve or modify the separate cover-design choices.
Designating the final file does not add, remove, or change the required back matter or author lines.
The final-file confirmation does not change the image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The source does not change the requirement to add manuscript page numbers or update table-of-contents pagination.
Confirming the final manuscript file does not alter the permitted image source or chapter-image suitability criteria.
The source does not cancel, complete, or otherwise modify the requested table-of-contents formatting review.
The final-file designation does not change chapter-image coverage, placement, presentation, or image selection.
The source does not resume or modify the deferred paragraph-spacing and body-density requirement.
The final-file confirmation does not change the italic styling or quotation-mark treatment for Mama's Hot Take sections.
The source does not modify the chapter-heading and subtitle formatting requirements.
